remarks: Quiet neighborhood street which has cul-de-sac in several directions. Spacious and open, this home has an open floor plan and the benefit of floor to ceiling windows for enjoyment of all seasons. Centered is a fireplace and surrounded by the updated kitchen with handsome cabinetry, a large center island framed with beams. Stainless steel appliances with wall oven, microwave, DW, and refrigerator. There is also a sunroom off the living room which can be used for play space for relaxing. It features 3 BRS, 2 updated BTHs on main level, Primary BR has its own BTH. Lower level has large family room space with FP. projection screen, 1/2 bath and office/BR. Laundry is also located there. Landlord has service contract with Standard Oil, tenant must purchase oil from them. Credit report through Rent Spree, last 3 paystubs, past landlord & references. Tenant must carry renters w/liability coverage. Tenant pays for all utilities, snow removal, & lawn care. Excellent credit a must.

facts.laundryLoc: Full size laundry in lower level.
